rv.q: FRANKENSTEIN: RESURRECTION is a creative way to take the story and move it forward organically.

With further attention paid to narrative clarity, more richly developed characters, and greater stylistic and emotional variety in its score, Frankenstein: Resurrection could well have what it takes to move beyond its Nocturne Theatre origins.
Frankenstein: Resurrection is an astonishing new musical production at the utterly sublime Nocturne Theatre, formerly the Glendale Center Theatre.
You’re always going to get a professional and polished Broadway-level production on the Nocturne’s mainstage, and this one is no different.

cn.t: Critics find this baroque rock musical sequel to Shelley's classic mostly successful, with strong praise for its gothic atmosphere and original premise, though it may primarily appeal to horror devotees.
